body_evidence.label: Hand across the body at release

explanation.basis: Compared with this athlete's 23 other analysed throws (same method version).
evidence: The carry (it landed 13 in shorter than usual).
The slide (it slid 15 in less than usual).
Release angle -6.3° against usual (noise 3.0°); on its own, in a drag-free flight, about 12 in less carry.
explanation.observed: Stopped on the board, 28 in short and 6 in right of the hole. First contact 13 in short of the usual spot.
explanation.possible_explanation: The difference arose after landing (the slide), not in the flight; no release measure accounts for a single throw's slide.
explanation.suggestion: Watch the landing in the side view (bag flat or on edge, spin) and compare with throws that stayed.

attribution.sentence: Board: 28 in short, 6 in right. About half of the short came from the slide (it slid 15 in less than usual).

auto_outcome.notes: Recorded automatically from the front camera; check the video and change it if it is wrong.

end.note: The bag stopped on the board and was still there when the clip ended.

slide.reason: The slide did not decelerate steadily up the deck (bounce or tumble).
